text: They have great vegetarian and vegan options. Loved everything and especially for the tempura bowl you get so much for the price with a salad and miso soup. Sushi was delicious. Would definitely always come back.

This was a charming sushi experience with decent prices, quality food and very professional and kind employees. The wasabi had some kick to it and the restaurant itself was well designed. I highly recommend I love Sushi if you're in the area.
I like my sushi choice. Was good. But no asahi beer. Also doesn’t feel you want to sit here for a long time. Just eat and go

The best Sushi variety and sushi all around in Chiang Mai! You will not be disappointed. 😋
We have been to a few other places and this is definitely the best.

I gave 'I Luv Sushi CNX' a try, meeting some friends there.  I like Japanese food a lot, but not particularly sushi.  It wasn't predominantly sushi and we had a reasonable cross section of food.  It was all 'just OK' but nothing special.

I didn't think it had any 'atmosphere' unlike the 'Samurai Kitchen' restaurants in Chiang Mai, which I like a lot.

This place is seriously good. They have great lunch deals and lots of food options for both meat eaters and non meat eaters. They have vegetarian/vegan options listed clearly on the menu and are also able to adapt other menu items like the yakisoba. If you're vegan, I highly recommend the yakisoba with vegetables! So good!

Delicious sushi 🍣 we had the lunch special pick any two rolls (5 pieces each) with miso soup and salad. We had the spicy tuna and crunchy roll as well as spicy salmon and sunrise salmon. We also ordered the Philadelphia roll and edamame. All rolls were delicious. We also qualified for the August promotion which gave us an extra salad and French fries. Everything was great and the service was wonderful.

This Sushi is off the chain delicious. We are originally from California, USA and this stuff is the real deal. Owner is amazing, staff is great, food is DELICIOUS. Great prices. Definitely check this place out. Keep them in business!!! We will for sure be coming back, again and again and again....

In my 40+ years in Thailand this is the WORST so-called Japanese food I have encountered!

The sashimi was excellent! Good quality fresh fish, well cooked and tasty.

However, as soon as they start cooking anything it becomes a monumental disaster!

The Gyoza was greasy, minimally filled and tasteless! Tops food court at half the price is infinitely better!

The Tempura was coated in a huge amount of batter, fried in old cheap oil, probably to disguise the fact they even cut one prawn in HALF to make two prawn tempura! Unbelievable!!!

The Taki Yaki (octopus balls) contained almost NO octopus and were simply lumps of glutinous stodge!

The California Roll was actually a minced “crab stick” roll!!! Something that never features in Japan, and any Japanese restaurateur would be ashamed of using such a vile ingredient!

The Chicken Teriyaki was a bland nothing !

Total bill was THB1,360 ... of which THB398 was for the excellent Sashimi.

Delivery was 50% off, so THB110, thanks to MealsOnWheels4You.com excellent promotion! As always arrived fast and hot.

The rest, THB850+ was for dog food .... and even my dogs were not impressed!

Give this place a MISS! Avoid at all costs!!!!

text: I Luv Sushi is, without a doubt, the best sushi spot in Chiang Mai. From the moment you walk in, the cozy atmosphere and welcoming staff set the tone for an unforgettable dining experience. The sushi is exceptional, with each piece carefully crafted to highlight the freshness and quality of the ingredients. The flavors are perfectly balanced, showcasing the restaurant’s commitment to authentic Japanese cuisine. Whether you’re a sushi enthusiast or just looking for a great meal, I Luv Sushi delivers a top-notch experience that’s hard to beat in Chiang Mai.

BEST SUSHI in Chiang Mai (we think) everything was super fresh, rolls crispy and I asked them to slice them thinner and they did it exactly right :)
February has a freebie promotion so we got some surprise crab salad and tofu sushi roll.
Pork Gyoza is a must. The Sunrise roll, sashimi and Crispy Roll (and the other roll I can’t remember) were delicious and fresh.
Thanks for a yummy perfect meal!

The best fusion sushi in town! I recommend the secret menu: Poke Bowl!  If you’re craving for American-style Sushi (but taste much better), you will love this place. Their fish is super fresh. The owner and staffs are very friendly and warm. Don’t miss this place.

The photo below is Sashimi Salad. 🥗

One of the best places I have eaten sushi in Chiang Mai.
They have an August promotion going where if you order a certain amount of food (price range) you get extra dishes.
Our whole meal cost 700 baht and we received a crab salad and side of fries with our meal.
They also refilled our hot tea that comes with ordering here.
We had the following:
Salmon roll
Spicy salmon roll
Crunchy roll
Spicy tuna roll
Philly roll
Great quality sushi.
Will definitely be back 😊

Clean space, friendly, helpful staff, and delicious food, for a very nice price. Don't miss out on their lunch special, Chicken Teriyaki or Yakisoba, with salad and all you can eat Miso soup for only 68 baht, or get a sashimi/sushi plate for 168 baht.
Fairly good price, and very friendly staff. Definitely a homey vibe where you can eat decent sushi.

We didn't like nor the ambience nor food. Fish under the glass looked poor and not fresh. Sushi were below average, overcooked rice. Hamachi was old and fell apart. They burned thin tuna, part without fat which is senseless and tastes 🥴. Also brought a portion of karaage as a promotion. It was also very old and you could only feel overfried oil. They definitely don't love sushi!
Food is amazing.  Had a hard time finding the server when we wanted to pay.

First of all, the lighting of this restaurant is very affective so I gave it a try with my friend . The food is good especially tofu salad is really good so I highly recommend you guys to try it and thier service is warm welcome and staffs is very friendly and useful.
We had lunch here, the price is good, and the atmosphere here is comfortable, but we think Sushi just ok.
Cozy/warm design. Great location.  Well trained friendly staff.  Great service/great food with generous portions.  Enjoy!!!
Well trained and helpful staff. Great food. The beef rolls is amazing!

Average food&price 🍣🍤
🥢I love atmosphere here and excellent services💛🙏. Thank youuuuuu …

Customer Service is good.
Food I had not tried.
Atmosphere Indeed fantastic! You will never regret!
Very-very delicious sushi 😍 Friendly atmosphere) You should definitely come here! …
My favorite Sushi place in CM. Simple and quick for lunch or dinner. Awesome staff, very kind and attentive. There’s easy side street parking as well which is always great.

I was looking for a clean sushi restaurant and it was about 3:00PM on a Sunday. I went by my self, and was happy to see the inside was just what I was looking for. The owner greeted me, and told me at 3 PM they have a Happy Hour for Sushi menu, etc, and full menu..the Tuna roll was perfect, the different types of sushi was great, and good size ...soup was very good, hot tea kept coming, and I’m going Back tomorrow..! I called my wife, and told her, we found a cute, clean Sushi Shop, that we can enjoy next time in Chiang Mai. I wish the owner the Best of Luck, because he and his staff were excellent in service.!

Nice atmosphere and the food tastes really fresh. I was savoring every bite. We got there at around 4 which was happy hour so got a half price Philly roll. They seem to have a lot of promotions going on. Highly recommend
Very good food,  attention to detail and fair prices. A recommendation for sure

After staying in Thailand for almost a week and trying all that fine thai-food, we decided to try a sushi-place for once. Having high expectation from a previous trip to Japan, we were not disappointed! The Sushi is as good as it gets this far from the ocean, I guess, and better then any Sushi restaurant I visited in Europe. The staff was very attentive. We didnt had to wait a mere second for placing an order or playing the bill. The food was deliciois and of high quality. The taste of the Sushi was balanced and delightful. We will return soon!
Excellent food and service in a cozy atmosphere! The sushi was super fresh and tasty as well as the warm dishes. I can highly recommend this place. Will come again whenever we are in Chiang Mai
Food was a little better than average. Service was poor.  Atmosphere was really nice.  Clean, well lighted.

I think this is one of the best Japanese restaurants in Chiang Mai. The sashimi is fresh, prices are reasonable, and the staff are super friendly and professional. The restaurant is also clean and has a great atmosphere. They also deliver, which is always a plus.
Nice atmosphere and design. Beautiful koi fish pool in the backyard.

This is the best sushi in Chiang Mai for sure. We have been on the hunt for several weeks for good quality sushi. This place hit the mark! And the price-point was very reasonable. We cannot wait to return!
Very tasty food. Great menu and excellent stuff!!

Good variety of maki rolls and sets of sushi/ maki rolls.
The decoration of the place of very nice and the service stands out from many other restaurants in Chiang mai.
Good value, sushi is tasty

Food is really good and yummy salmons are so fresh and staff’s service is fast and they are so polite:) when I compare price and quality they deserve absolutely 💯. If you have budget around 100-200 baht per person here will make you happy and full
Fabulous food, great service, super friendly staff.
Let the pictures explain the quality
WOW! Amazing food, high quality ingredients amd superb staff.  The owner is always on site and takes his time to explain where he sources his products.  Always a pleasure eating at I LuV Sushi CnX.
Absolutely FANTASTIC sushi!!!!!  Clean, welcoming atmosphere and perfect service!  Do yourself a favor and recharge your batteries at this gem!  The tuna tataki sushi is magical!!!!!  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great place. Food excellent, service impeccable, friendly,warm staff. Excellent value for the money.
This is a nice Japanese restaurant and a great place to get a vegan meal, which can be tricky in many Japanese restaurants. Veggie sushi and miso soup hit the spot!
Really delicious food. They have great vegan options too and very affordable lunch time sets.
Best sushi in Chiang Mai. The sets are amazing and a really good deal!
Delicious food and great service a few minutes away from work. Great option for lunch timr. Will surely become a regular here.
My favourite sushi place in town, always fresh fish and awesome noodles!
Midso Japanese restaurant, well presented  and worth it for the price we pay. They have promotions for the month of February.
Best suchi and sashimi place in Chiang Mai. Quality and affordable. Highly recommended

The food was incredibly delicious! The salad and soup were amazing. I came because of the discount promotion and I plan to bring my friends to eat here again. The atmosphere was great, clean, and comfortable. The staff provided excellent service.
The rolls we ordered were served quickly, they were quite generous and delicious. Better value for money than other places in Chiang Mai for sushi.

A treat for meat-eaters and vegetarians alike.
Good quality Japanese food at reasonable prices. Delicious taste and a wide variety of menu options.
A Japanese restaurant with a simple yet charming setting. They offer a complete range of standard sushi, sashimi, and other Japanese dishes. Everything is fresh and clean.

This is my fifth time eating at this Japanese restaurant! The salmon sashimi I ordered today was the worst I've ever had. The meat wasn't firm at all, and the color wasn't vibrant either; it just had a slight sheen. Has salmon become more expensive in Chiang Mai recently? It was 288 baht for six slices, and I ordered two. The salmon was sliced ​​as thin as the accompanying lemon slices, and the texture was completely different from what I've had before. I was very disappointed with my dining experience. Plus, a waiter walked right past me drinking a beverage; the restaurant's management has some issues!
